regime_context: Policy regime is a sequenced, incentive-aligned campaign: the Fed under Warsh banks hawkish credibility now (inflation-mandate first) while Treasury suppresses long yields structurally via bill-heavy issuance and T-bill reinvestment, and industrial policy steers capital into chips/nuclear/defense. Consensus narrative treats 'coordinated' easing as imminent; revealed preference suggests the administration wants lower real yields without near-term cut optics, so the front end stays supported while duration and rate-sensitive cyclical calls carry two-sided risk.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是一场有序推进、激励对齐的运动：沃什领导下的美联储当前以通胀使命为先、积累鹰派信誉，而财政部通过偏重短债发行和再投资短债在结构上压低长端收益率，产业政策则将资本导向芯片、核能与国防。市场共识叙事把“协同宽松”视为迫在眉睫；但显示性偏好表明，政府想要更低的实际收益率，却不愿在近期降息上留下通胀失控的观感，因此短端仍获支撑，而久期与利率敏感型周期品种面临双向风险。

theses.subject: KBE
theses.thesis: Warsh's narrower, hike-majority Fed keeps front-end pressure and a strict 2% mandate; regional banks carrying duration and CRE exposure bear the cost of high-for-longer short rates even as Treasury flattens the long end via T-bill issuance.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什主导的美联储框架更窄、市场预期偏加息，且坚守严格的 2% 目标；区域银行持有久期和商业地产敞口，将承受短端利率长期高企的成本，即便财政部通过短债发行压低长端。
evidence: Fed path gap shows end-2026 at ~4.0-4.1% with hike-majority FedWatch probabilities (Sept hike >70%)
Warsh Sintra response held hawkish line on hot May PCE; no easing signal
Recent KBE overweight (2026-07-10) missed -8.2% — rate-sensitive regional banks are fragile in this regime
theses.dissent: If the July 28-29 hold morphs into a labor-crack-driven September pivot, regional banks would re-rate sharply higher on easing expectations; the front-end steepener is the strongest contrary case.
theses.dissent_zh: 如果 7 月 28-29 日按兵不动后，因就业数据走弱而在 9 月转向宽松，区域银行将因降息预期而大幅重新定价；短端陡峭化是最有力的反方论点。

falsifier.text: KBE outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date without a Fed cut being priced
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，KBE 在未被市场定价降息的情况下相对 SPY 领先 5%

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The tech-war transition and pending Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) keep the domestic-fab tariff premium in place contingent on a clean handoff after Section 122 expires July 24; industrial-policy capital rotation favors US semiconductor onshoring.
theses.thesis_zh: 科技战过渡期及即将落地的 301 条款替代方案（约 12.5%）在 122 条款 7 月 24 日到期后若能顺利衔接，将维持本土晶圆制造的关税溢价；产业政策资本轮动有利于美国半导体本土化。
evidence: China theater flagged onshoring bid persists contingent on Section 301 handoff
Advanced-chip 25% tariff staying in force is an open prediction still live
Prior SMH overweight (2026-07-10) hit +1.4%, consistent with chip-policy premium
theses.dissent: A China tariff truce extension or a clean strike-down of the 301 replacement would remove the protection premium and unwind the relative SMH bid against broad tech.
theses.dissent_zh: 若中美关税休战延长，或 301 条款替代方案被法院明确推翻，将消除保护性溢价，并逆转 SMH 相对整体科技板块的超额收益。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date while the Section 301 replacement remains in force
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，SMH 在 301 条款替代方案仍有效的情况下相对 SPY 落后 5%

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse (7/8) re-primes an upside-skewed oil bid; Brent already spiked ~$80, energy was the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026, and headline-fragile supply risk persists as long as Hormuz transit is threatened.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火协议破裂（7 月 8 日）重新点燃上行偏向的油价行情；布伦特原油已飙升至约 80 美元，能源板块是 2026 年第一季度 ETF 流入最多的板块，只要霍尔木兹海峡运输受到威胁，供应端的头条风险就持续存在。
evidence: Ceasefire collapse theater: Brent ~$80 intraday 7/8, US strikes on Iran 7/8-11
Energy was top ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 (first in years)
theses.dissent: A rapid diplomatic de-escalation or surprise SPR-style release would crush the headline premium; oil is the most two-sided call in the substrate.
theses.dissent_zh: 若外交局势迅速降温，或出现意外释放战略储备的动作，将抹去油价中的消息面溢价；原油是本情报材料中最具双向性的标的。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date while Brent stays above $75
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，XLE 在布伦特原油维持在 75 美元上方的情况下相对 SPY 落后 5%
